title: Multi-seed replication of the window-provisioning law
one_line: p1c/p1d established the law on a single model (seed 2100). p1e trains seeds 2101 and 2102 across the same four window cells and asks whether the law is a property of the architecture-plus-window or a property of that one model.
why_this_matters: Everything the programme currently calls a 'law' rests on n=1 at the model level. p1d's own limitations list says so first: 'ONE SEED (2100) per cell. This settles the ordering question FOR THIS MODEL and cannot upgrade a single-seed result into a law; model-level variance is unestimated at n=1.' p1e is the single experiment that discharges that limitation. Nothing else in the queue changes what the paper is allowed to claim.

design.training_recipe: UNCHANGED from p1c. S05_BATCH=16, S05_ARMS=stablegla, S05_BLOCK=1024, S05_TOKENS=1200000000, S05_NEEDLE_MIX=0.10, S05_KV_MIX=0.10, 73243 steps. The ONLY changed variable is S05_SEED.
design.why_seed_is_a_real_replicate: runner.py:134 reads S05_SEED, then uses it for BOTH torch.manual_seed(seed)/model.reinitialize_named(seed) (initialisation) AND T.get_batch(..., seed*1_000_003+step) (data order). Changing it therefore produces an independently initialised model trained on an independently ordered stream, not a re-scoring of the same model.
design.battery: IDENTICAL to p1d's frozen battery, reused byte-for-byte. It was generated and salted before any p1e checkpoint existed, so it cannot have been tuned to these models. Reusing it also makes the seed comparison exact: the same items, the same order, the same predictions.

preregistered_gates.G0_prerequisite: w1024 Battery-A accuracy >= 0.90 in BOTH new seeds, else INCONCLUSIVE for that seed (battery or training broken, not a refutation of the law).
preregistered_gates.G1_positive_control: kv accuracy >= 0.80 in all 8 new cells. This is the control p1b failed and p1c repaired; it must be re-earned, not assumed.
preregistered_gates.G2_reproduction: Before scoring any new checkpoint, re-score seed 2100's checkpoints on this same battery and reproduce p1d's reported values exactly (0.262695/0.477539/0.725098/0.995117). On failure the whole run is VOID. This is the only defence against models.py reading its attention window from an import-time global (S05_WINDOW), which fails silently with plausible output.
preregistered_gates.G4_ordering: each adjacent gap (w256-w128, w512-w256, w1024-w512) >= 0.15, in each of the two new seeds independently.
preregistered_gates.G5_step_function: per cell: accuracy >= 0.90 on strata with d < W-16, and <= 0.05 on strata with d > W+16.
preregistered_gates.G6_cross_seed_consistency: per window, the spread max(observed) - min(observed) across the three seeds {2100, 2101, 2102} <= 0.10. This is the gate that actually earns the word 'law': it asks whether model-level variance is small compared with the 0.21-0.27 between-window gaps the law predicts.
preregistered_gates.G7_boundary: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY, never gates. Report the empirical step location per cell, and specifically whether the w512 cells again recall needles at distance exactly 512 despite a strict '<' mask (the stacked-sliding-window receptive-field effect seen in p1b and p1c). Two more seeds either replicate that effect or bound it.
preregistered_gates.pass_if: G0 and G1 and G2 and G3 and G4 and G5 and G6
preregistered_gates.no_efficacy_stopping: All 8 cells train to the full 73243 steps regardless of what the first cells show. No early stop, no cell added or dropped after the fact.

interpretation_fixed_in_advance.all_gates_pass: LAW_REPLICATES_ACROSS_SEEDS. The window-provisioning result may be stated as a property of the architecture-and-window rather than of one model, and p1d's n=1 limitation is discharged rather than merely disclosed.
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.G6_fails_only: LAW_HOLDS_BUT_SEED_VARIANCE_MATERIAL. The ordering and step-function structure survive but the quantitative ceiling is model-dependent; the paper must report a spread, not a point prediction, and the patent's lead claim must be worded to the structure rather than the number.
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.G3_or_G4_or_G5_fails: LAW_DOES_NOT_REPLICATE. This is a refutation of the programme's commercial thesis on its own pre-registered terms and must be reported as such, immediately and unhedged, ahead of any other finding.
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.G2_fails: VOID. Instrument fault, no claim either way, re-run after fixing.
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.note: These readings are fixed now, before data. Per the standing rule that killed the temptation in p1c: a pre-registered gate is never amended after seeing the result. New questions get new campaigns.

execution_shape.constraint: gx3-48x240x2l40s is 48 vCPU (verified live 2026-08-01) and this account's spot quota is 100 vCPU (S05-BUILD.md:563, :834). Two instances = 96/100 fit; a third returns over_quota. The handover's '4 x 2-GPU L40S, ~21h wall' is therefore not achievable.
execution_shape.resolution: TWO SEQUENTIAL WAVES of 2 instances x 2 GPUs = 4 cells each. Wave A = seed 2101, wave B = seed 2102. Dollar cost is unchanged (cost is GPU-hours); wall time roughly doubles to ~46h.

wave_B.boots_from: image captured at end of wave A

execution_shape.image_capture: p1c_bootstrap.sh's header recorded that capturing an image after a successful bootstrap turns every future provision into a ~3-minute boot instead of ~2 billed hours of driver install + venv + 5.1GB corpus transfer. It was never actioned: the account holds 0 private images and 0 snapshots (verified live 2026-08-01). Wave A captures one once its corpus sha256 verifies, and wave B uses it.

limitations: Three seeds is enough to show that seed variance is small relative to the effect; it is not enough to put a confidence interval on the ceiling. n=3 at the model level.
Still one architecture (stablegla), one scale (110M), one training recipe, one corpus. p1e widens exactly one axis: the model seed.

The battery is reused rather than regenerated, so evaluation-draw variance is deliberately held fixed at zero. That is the right choice for isolating model variance, but it means p1e says nothing about battery-draw variance.
The needle battery is held out in filler, placement and (K,V,position) combination, but not in content: the training needle pool draws from the same 65-word vocabulary.
